modelNotes: Minutes Engine 1.1 uses player-pool status plus season, last 5, and last 10 minutes from NBA history.
Unknown starters retain their historical minutes baseline and are not treated as confirmed bench players.
Missing injury information does not mean a player is cleared; publication eligibility requires confirmed game status and role.
Roles are Core Starter, Starter, Rotation, Bench, Deep Bench, and Inactive.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Smith went back to the locker room during Wednesday's game against the Knicks after suffering an apparent finger injury, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.
injury.detail: Smith appeared to hurt his finger contesting a shot from OG Anuonoby, and for now, he should be considered questionable to return. If he needs to miss time, Zach Collins, Leonard Miller and Noa Essengue would help pick up the slack.

injury.shortComment: Knueppel (hamstring) exited to the locker room in the first quarter of Wednesday's game against the Nets, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.
injury.detail: Knueppel was cleared to make his season debut Wednesday after dealing with a left hamstring strain. However, he limped back to the locker room midway through the opening quarter and can be considered questionable to return until more information comes to light.

injury.shortComment: Newell won't return to Wednesday's game against the Wizards due to a left great toe hyperextension, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports. He'll finish with two points (1-1 FG), three rebounds and three assists across 10 minutes.
injury.detail: Newell won't return during the second half, opening up additional minutes for guys like Aaron Wiggins and Corey Kispert in Jalen Johnson's (ankle) absence. Newell's next chance to play will come in Friday's rematch against Washington.

injury.shortComment: Capela (ankle) is out for Wednesday's game against the Timberwolves.
injury.detail: The veteran big man is nursing a sprained right ankle, which is costing him a second consecutive contest. His next chance to return arrives Saturday, when the Rockets visit the Suns in Phoenix.

injury.shortComment: Landale is out for Wednesday's game against the Wizards with a left hip strain, Kevin Chouinard of the Hawks' official site reports.
injury.detail: Landale is sidelined for a second consecutive game with the injury. Zuby Ejiofor should handle the No. 2 center spot for as long as Landale is on the shelf.

injury.shortComment: Oubre (calf) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.
injury.detail: Oubre missed Indiana's last game with a bruised left knee and will miss a second straight game due to a left calf contusion. His next chance to play will come Saturday against Denver. In the meantime, Quenton Jackson and Jarace Walker will likely see increased playing time.

injury.shortComment: Head coach Ime Udoka said Wednesday that Adams (calf) is still without a timetable to return and will be evaluated on a "weekly basis," Varun Shankar of the Houston Chronicle reports.
injury.detail: Adams hasn't played since Oct. 23 due to a right soleus strain and remains without a definitive timetable to return. Oscar Tshiebwe figures to see increased burn until Capela (ankle) or Adams returns.

injury.shortComment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
injury.detail: Simmons had a quality preseason, averaging 10.5 points, 4.0 rebounds and 4.0 assists over 17.4 minutes per contest (two games). The 30-year-old was on track to suit up for the Kings on opening night, though those plans were halted after he suffered a torn Achilles tendon during practice. Now, Simmons will focus on rehab. However, it's unknown what the future holds regarding his career in the NBA.

injury.shortComment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
injury.detail: Beal is dealing with knee inflammation that will keep him sidelined for Opening Night. While it's unclear how long the Clippers will be without the veteran guard, Darius Garland, Keaton Wagler and Kris Dunn should dominate the backcourt minutes in his absence. Beal's 2025-26 campaign was cut short by a hip injury after he averaged 8.2 points and 1.7 assists in 20.6 minutes across just six regular-season appearances.

players.statusSource: ESPN team roster; game availability not confirmed

injury.shortComment: The Clippers recalled Ingram (Achilles) from the G League's San Diego Clippers on Sunday.
injury.detail: Ingram appears to be making steady progress after missing the opening run of the 2026-27 season through a partial Achilles tear, although it remains unclear when he'll be an option again for the Clippers and how quickly he'll regain playing time. Having worked with the G League squad Sunday, the versatile man is back with the main team, and his eventual return to action will restore a major piece of the rotation. However, while Ingram remains out, Darius Garland and Kris Dunn look set to carry most of the workload in upcoming contests.

injury.shortComment: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against the Kings.
injury.detail: Although there haven't been any negative reports regarding Lively's rehab progress, it doesn't appear he will be back in the lineup anytime soon. For now, the 22-year-old should be considered week-to-week. While Lively remains on the shelf, Daniel Gafford and Moussa Cisse should continue to handle most of the work at the five. Santi Aldama (knee) might also get involved in that area once he's cleared to return.

injury.shortComment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
injury.detail: The Spurs are expected to exercise extreme caution with the big man, as Quaintance suffered a torn ACL and meniscus with Arizona State in February 2025 before appearing in only four games with Kentucky last season due to severe complications and persistent swelling. The 19-year-old underwent a cleanup procedure on his meniscus in mid-July, and the Spurs will likely want him at 100 percent before ramping him up to basketball activities.

injury.shortComment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.
injury.detail: It's a tough break for Miller, who had an opportunity to battle for a reserve role during training camp in the fall. The timeline for a return is likely to keep him on the shelf until after the All-Star break. Miller's extended stay on the sidelines gives Kobe Sanders a chance to crack the Clippers' rotation.

injury.detail: Raynaud's absence is expected to extend into mid-November due to a right patellar subluxation. With Dylan Cardwell (calf) set to miss at least one more week, Precious Achiuwa, Jonathan Mogbo and De'Andre Hunter are candidates for increased minutes in the frontcourt.

injury.detail: Biberovic has been battling inflammation in his right heel, preventing him from making his NBA debut. While the rookie should be considered week-to-week, he likely has a way to go before earning a meaningful role in Dallas even when he's cleared to suit up.

injury.shortComment: Harris (calf) is listed as out for Saturday's game against Minnesota.
injury.detail: Harris suffered a strained left calf ahead of the 2026-27 campaign and has yet to make his debut with the Spurs. The veteran is slowly making progress toward a return, though he should be considered week-to-week until more information is released. The 34-year-old, who signed with San Antonio during the offseason, averaged 13.3 points, 5.1 rebounds and 2.5 assists over 27.7 minutes per contest in 63 regular-season appearances with the Pistons in 2025-26.

injury.shortComment: The Clippers recalled Niederhauser (foot) from the G League's San Diego Clippers on Sunday.
injury.detail: Niederhauser remains unlikely to play a meaningful role in the short term following a seven-month recovery from foot surgery. The 23-year-old might instead make a phased return to action, possibly seeing limited minutes at some point in upcoming weeks and making some appearances in the G League. Last season, he averaged 4.3 points, 2.9 rebounds and 0.3 assists per regular-season game during his rookie year.
